taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-09, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 975.4 | 1.86 | 1.86
2 | 552.4 | 22.73 | 24.59
3 | 730.5 | 1.22 | 25.81
4 | 1710.8 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as HA-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station T-09, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

**Site Note – Station T-09, Survey Area T**

The interpreted VES model at T-09 comprises four layers. Resistivity decreases from 975.4 Ω·m (Layer 1, 0–1.86 m) to 552.4 Ω·m (Layer 2, 1.86–24.59 m), then increases to 730.5 Ω·m (Layer 3, 24.59–25.81 m) and further to 1710.8 Ω·m (Layer 4, basement, below 25.81 m).

Applying the curve-type rule: for layers 1-2-3 (975.4 > 552.4 < 730.5) the pattern is H; for layers 2-3-4 (552.4 < 730.5 < 1710.8) the pattern is A. This gives a combined curve type of HA, consistent with the four-layer, two-letter convention.

The on-file classification (HA-type) matches the computed resistivity sequence. No discrepancy was found between the interpreted model and the stated curve type. Drilling planning may proceed using the HA-type classification as recorded.

{"curve_type_stated": "HA", "label_issue_flagged": false}
